## Freed v26.10.500-dev

Clearer Friends loading and safer outbox ownership

### Fixes

- Show the shared loading indicator while Friends activity loads
- Retain outbox ownership until timed-out work settles, preventing a replacement drain from overlapping it
- Recognize standalone Sponsored disclosures on Facebook posts

### Follow-ups

- Hung outbox work can remain pending; cancellation and screen-lock admission are separate follow-ups
- Broader Facebook paid-placement and nested organic classification remain outside this change
- Signed installed UI acceptance and passive deadline-path observation remain separate verification steps

### Downloads

**macOS:** `.dmg` (Apple Silicon or Intel, signed + notarized)  
**Windows:** `.exe` (NSIS installer)  
**Linux:** `.AppImage`  

> macOS downloads are signed and notarized for normal Gatekeeper installation.
